annotations.title: VPS prices that changed this week

description: Use for «which VPS got cheaper this week», «hosts that raised prices». Plans across the whole catalog whose monthly price went down or up over the last 1-30 days (default 7): how many got cheaper and dearer, and the plans with the biggest moves (host, plan, old and new price, per cent, date). Only real price moves by the hosts, not exchange rates or data corrections.

kind.description: vps, hosting (shared web hosting), dedicated or any.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; also the price currency: ru = RUB, en = USD, de/es/pt = EUR, tr = TRY.
